name: Privacy
notes: Opt-in, local data, what leaves the computer

features.feature: Nothing is recorded unless the user opts in for that call; a meeting series records only when set to
Only Teams' audio is recorded as the other side (macOS)
No audio is kept once a call is transcribed, unless Keep audio files is on
Transcription works offline, on the computer or a server the user connected
Echo connects only where the user expects (their AI profile, Microsoft 365, GitHub for updates and marketplaces, their servers)
Sign-in tokens and keys are private files and never logged
A call's text goes only to the AI profile pinned to it
Text from others (titles, transcripts, chat, minutes, mail, names, plugin text) is shown as text, never run: no markup or script from it takes effect
A Claude Code session sends or creates nothing on the user's behalf (mail, Teams message, task) without an explicit yes to that item
